url.description: A2A endpoint of the IT Provisioning Agent (apps/it-provisioning-agent), scheme included
A2A endpoint of the Office Concierge Agent (apps/office-concierge-agent), scheme included
Base URL of the Employee DB MCP Server (apps/employee-db-app), scheme included. The /mcp path is appended by the transport setting in agent-network.yaml
Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible endpoint, scheme included, up to and including the version path (e.g. https://host/openai/v1)

clientId.description: Client ID of the LLM endpoint (username when it uses Basic authentication)

clientSecret.description: Client secret of the LLM endpoint (password when it uses Basic authentication)

apiKey.description: API key sent as the apiKey of the llm connection. For a proxy fronted by Basic authentication this is base64(clientId:clientSecret); for a plain OpenAI-compatible endpoint it is the raw key
